primary.label: Primary comparison
primary.description: 144 paired protected configurations; 48 paired clean controls. Three baseline orders per configuration, one deterministic RAVET order.

compression.label: Compression
compression.description: All documents summarized; with or without topic transfer. Two corpus/transfer draws, each with eight paired configurations per state.

paraphrase.label: Paraphrase
paraphrase.description: Sentinel-only paraphrase; ordinary documents unchanged. Eight paired protected configurations.

expansion.label: Knowledge expansion
expansion.description: 48 expanded configurations and eight unexpanded references. All original carriers retained.

retrieval.label: Retrieval and indexing
retrieval.description: Eight paired configurations per reconfiguration; Top-5 reference, Top-3, Top-1, and re-chunking.
